11. Expansion to one thousand programs

At 1,000 programs with 2 nmol initiator each, the same organization consumes per cycle:

120 µmol packets.
40 µmol of 50-nucleotide program strands, before caps and other fuels.
Twenty thousand ordered program-module placements across the library.

Shared codons can reduce the number of distinct packets. They do not make ordered program loading free.

At a hypothetical 30 nm site pitch, the occupied area would be approximately 1,084 m². That is a geometric screen; porous-support area is useful only if the complete register, reactants and wash flow can access it.

At 6–20 minutes of analysis per resolved product, one thousand products require 100–333 instrument-hours, before controls. Additional instruments can reduce elapsed time but must be paid. Pooling cannot simply replace resolution because of the demonstrated sequence ambiguity.
